_comment: THESIS FUND presets. Each key is a THESIS the producer can express. 'long'/'short' are the basket — assets the thesis is biased long/short. The producer only PRESSES a name when the market confirms that direction (trend + momentum aligned); it skips names fighting the thesis and de-risks via DSL. Opposing presets are just flipped baskets. Asset names use HL conventions: bare ticker for main-DEX crypto (BTC/ETH/SOL/HYPE), 'xyz:' prefix for XYZ (indices/metals/energy). Names not live on the instrument board are skipped automatically. Add/edit presets here — no code change needed.

risk_off.name: Risk-Off — Bet Against the Trump Economy
risk_off.summary: US growth disappoints, risk assets fall, capital flees to hard assets. Long gold/metals, short US equity indices + BTC. Presses only as the move confirms.

recovery.name: U.S. Recovery — Risk-On
recovery.summary: US growth re-accelerates, risk bid returns, hard assets soften. The mirror of risk_off: long US indices + BTC, short gold.

war_escalation.name: War Escalation — Iran/US/Israel Quagmire
war_escalation.summary: Conflict deepens: oil spikes on supply fear, gold bid as a safe haven, equities and risk sell off. Long oil + gold, short indices + BTC.

war_recovery.name: War De-escalation — Recovery
war_recovery.summary: Conflict cools: oil unwinds its risk premium, safe-haven gold fades, risk assets recover. Short oil + gold, long indices + BTC.

hype_vs_market.name: HYPE vs. the Rest of the Market
hype_vs_market.summary: HYPE keeps outrunning the majors. Long HYPE, short the BTC/ETH/SOL basket — profit from the dispersion, roughly market-neutral.

gold_over_btc.name: Gold over Bitcoin — Real Gold Wins
gold_over_btc.summary: The flight-to-real-safety trade: gold outperforms 'digital gold'. Long gold, short BTC.

btc_over_gold.name: Bitcoin over Gold — Digital Gold Wins
btc_over_gold.summary: The inverse: BTC takes share from gold as the reserve hedge. Long BTC, short gold.
